top_signals.title: US Bond Selloff Drives 30-Year Yields to the Highest Since 2007
top_signals.summary: The yield on 30-year US Treasuries hit the highest in almost two decades, reflecting investor angst over the surging national debt, a flood of long-dated bond sales and inflation that’s been stuck over the Federal Reserve’s target for the past five years.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.summary: CleanSpark is up 6.4% year to date, while BitFuFu and Canaan have fallen more than 50% and 70%, respectively.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
